name: golding-work
description: Claude Code plugins from Golding Software for running client work with Claude: a work room per client, and PR review that checks the change against its ticket.

plugins.name: work-room
plugins.description: A ready-to-edit Claude Code room for one client or project: an orchestrator that sizes each request, a Haiku/Sonnet/Opus worker ladder, a shared register so parallel sessions don't collide.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: PR review that checks the change against its ticket as well as the code: a GitHub Actions workflow you install with one skill, an editable rubric, and the same review on demand in a session.
